description: This Kotlin file defines the EditRecipeBottomSheet class, which is a UI component for adding or editing recipes in an Android app. It manages views such as text fields, a spinner for categories, a checkbox for favorites, and handles user interactions to save or update recipe data via shared view models.

classes.name: EditRecipeBottomSheet
classes.description: A BottomSheetDialogFragment subclass for creating or editing a recipe, handling UI initialization, data binding, and interaction.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of EditRecipeBottomSheet with an optional recipe ID for editing.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and loads a recipe if editId is provided.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout resource for the bottom sheet.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI components, observers for categories and recipe data, and handles save button clicks.
